agent_vs_you: Most of the plan is mine too: a generated plain white sneaker, two flux edits for detail and profile views, three 5 s image-to-video shots, one silent assemble at 15 s, then code captions in the safe area. The failure is the last node. The agent put all three captions into one text-overlay, with "caption 1 from: 0; to: 5; caption 2 from: 5; to: 10; caption 3 from: 10; to: 15" in extra. The executor joined every quoted string in the prompt with newlines into ONE card, and text-overlay.js reads only the first "from:"/"to:" pair. So all three captions appear stacked for 0–5 s and nothing appears after that. The agent stretched a format the tool does not parse (in H42a it correctly used one node per caption), but the tool merged them silently instead of honouring the windows or refusing. I would chain three text-overlay nodes, one caption and one window each, all at middle.

fix: Change text-overlay so that when the prompt holds N quoted captions and extra holds N from/to windows (or "caption k from:"), it renders one card per caption for its own window. Today the executor joins all quotes into one card and the tool uses only the first window. Otherwise it should refuse, so the planner chains nodes. Add the planner rule "one text-overlay node per timed caption" and expose a size or max-width so safe-area margins can be met. This covers every timed caption or subtitle sequence.
